summary: Examples of the password lookup creating MySQL users with random passwords of set length and character sets, a random Kubernetes pod name via /dev/null, and an idempotent seeded password for CI.
questions: How do I create a MySQL user with a random password stored per client?
How do I generate an 8-digit numeric password?
How do I make a random lowercase pod name?

answer_card.title: password lookup examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
password: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.password', 'credentials/' + client + '/' + tier + '/' + role + '/mysqlpassword', length=15) }}"

password: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.password', '/tmp/passwordfile', chars=['ascii_letters']) }}"

password: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.password', '/tmp/passwordfile', length=8, chars=['digits']) }}"

random_pod_name: "web-{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.password', '/dev/null', chars=['ascii_lowercase', 'digits'], length=8) }}"

# idempotent, for testing/CI only
password: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.password', '/dev/null', seed=inventory_hostname) }}"
```
